description: This file declares validation functions for various radio network configurations related to serving cell settings, including PDCCH, PDSCH, PUCCH, PUSCH, SRS, and CSI-RS configurations, within the ocudu namespace.

methods.name: validate_pdcch_cfg
methods.description: Validates PDCCH configuration in a UE serving cell configuration, returning an error message if invalid.

methods.name: validate_pdsch_cfg
methods.description: Validates PDSCH configuration in a UE serving cell configuration, returning an error message if invalid.

methods.name: validate_pucch_cfg
methods.description: Validates PUCCH configuration with resource list and common config, returning an error message if invalid.

methods.name: validate_pusch_cfg
methods.description: Validates PUSCH uplink configuration, considering CSI enablement, returning an error message if invalid.

methods.name: validate_srs_cfg
methods.description: Validates SRS configuration based on UE serving cell and UL BWP CRB interval, returning an error message if invalid.

methods.name: validate_nzp_csi_rs_list
methods.description: Validates NZP-CSI-RS resource list with optional TDD configuration, returning an error message if invalid.

methods.name: validate_csi_meas_cfg
methods.description: Validates CSI measurement configuration with optional TDD config and UL common config, returning an error message if invalid.
